BabyBlues.1:
Baby blues d tigemmi n wul
deffir tlalit
BabyBlues.2: Ẓer acu i izemren ad yettbeddil deg wul deffir tlalit, tessneḍ melmi ara tessutureḍ tallelt.
BabyBlues.8: Deffir tlalit, d ayen amagnu ad tḥuss s wul akk ugar. Baby blues, s umata, ur d-yettɛeṭṭil ara, maca ma yeqqim neɣ yettazzad usemmiḍ, yessefk ad tessuturd tallelt n unaẓur.
BabyBlues.14: Baby blues neɣ tuddsa n deffir tlalit?
BabyBlues.19: Baby blues d aẓɣal n ubeddil n wul i izemren ad d-yeḍru deg ussan imezwura deffir tlalit. Ibeddilen n hormone, ṭṭṛaḥ, ɣilen n tuɣmest d usemras n ddeqs-a amaynut zemren akk ad d-sawḍen ɣer tuḥsest-a.
BabyBlues.20: Wagi mačči d ukkes n tezmert, ur yeɛni ara tella d yemma-s n uqcic ur ihelken ara. Yal yiwen yesɛa abrid-is deg ussan imezwura n deffir tlalit.
BabyBlues.22: Baby blues yettwaẓran deffir tlalit, yettaɣ-d ad yelhu s timmad-is deg kra n wussan.
BabyBlues.25: Ayen i d-yettwaẓran yettwanaw. Kra ttḥussen akkenni s ṭṭṛaḥ d tuḥsest, wiyaḍ zemren ad ɛerḍen ibeddilen n wul ugar.
BabyBlues.27: Tebkiḍ s lqella neɣ tḥussed s tuḥsest yezwiren.
BabyBlues.29: Iḥulfan zemren ad ḥussen d iqwayen u ad beddlen s lemɛna.
BabyBlues.31: Tuḥsest n ucebbub zemren ad tbeddel d tawsit n lehna.
BabyBlues.33: Ṭṭṛaḥ n wussan imezwura izemren ad yesseqweṛ iḥulfan.
BabyBlues.36: Deg wakud-a, ilaq ad tnefseḍ aṭas. Tiɣawsiwin timecṭaḥ d tilemzit zemrent ad sselhint ussan.
BabyBlues.38: Seqdec ayen akk yellan n yimikan ilelliyen i usentem.
BabyBlues.40: Ur tettaggadeḍ ara ad tessutureḍ tallelt ɣer wid i k-yezzin.
BabyBlues.42: Qqim teswiḍ aman ilaqen deg wass.
BabyBlues.45: “Ad tessutureḍ tallelt deffir tlalit d abrid n tuɣǧa n yiman-ik d uqcic-ik amecṭuḥ.”
BabyBlues.47: Baby blues neɣ tuddsa n deffir tlalit?
BabyBlues.48: Baby blues, s umata, mecṭuḥ-it u yettlelli ɣef kra kra. Tuddsa n deffir tlalit temxalef: tezmer ad teqqim aṭas, ad tettazzad, ad tesɛu azal ameqqran ɣef tudert n yal ass.
BabyBlues.49: Sin n waddaden ilaqen ad ttwasefrqen
BabyBlues.51: Aṭas-nni d amecṭuḥ, yettlelli kra kra deg wussan i d-iteddun.
BabyBlues.53: Tezmer ad teqqim aṭas, ad tettazzad u ad teḥwaǧ tallelt n unaẓur.
BabyBlues.56: Yelha ad tmeslayeḍ d unaẓur n tezmert ma yella usemmiḍ n wul ur yelli ara, yettazzad neɣ yebda yessenhez tudert n yal ass.
BabyBlues.57: Tiwsatin n useɣwen ilaqen ad tbeddeḍ
BabyBlues.59: Isenfaren qqimen ugar n sin n yimalasen.
BabyBlues.61: Yewɛer ad tḥerseḍ iman-ik neɣ uqcic-ik amecṭuḥ.
BabyBlues.64: Tqabalt, aṭṭbib, anaẓur n tfekka neɣ unaẓur-nniḍen n tezmert zemren ad k-ssefhmen, ad ssenqden aḍris u ad k-fken tallelt tameɛqult.
BabyBlues.66: Iḥulfan n deffir tlalit mačči d azal n wacu i telhid d yemma. Tesɛiḍ azref ad teḥwaǧeḍ anfas, ad k-sentemen u ad k-ɛawnen.
BabyBlues.70: Ṭṭṛaḥ d ibeddilen n hormone zemren ad ḥekmen ɣef ccḥal n wul.
BabyBlues.71: Tallelt n wid i k-yezzin tezmer ad tselhu tallalt-a.
BabyBlues.72: Usemmiḍ yeqqimen neɣ ameqqran yessefk ad yettwasenqed s unaẓur.
BabyBlues.73: Amagrad-a d i ussenfar kan, ur yettekkes ara tallelt n ṭṭbib. Ma tesɛiḍ ccek neɣ tḥussed s usemmiḍ ameqqran, mmeslay d unaẓur n tezmert.
BabyBlues.74: Ad tḥerseḍ iman-ik daɣen d aḥric n deffir tlalit.

BabyDevelopment.1:
Tigga n uqcic-ik amecṭuḥ
deg ugni
BabyDevelopment.6: Amek i d-yettergigi uqcic-ik amecṭuḥ, trimestre ɣef trimestre.
BabyDevelopment.14: Seg dduṛt 6 n ddurt, ul amecṭuḥ yebda ittaḍḍu. Deg trimestre amezwaru-a, yiweḍ-d ad d-yettuxdem yiwen yiwen yiɣsan imeqqranen.
BabyDevelopment.16: Aḍḍuḍ n ul n uqcic amecṭuḥ d yiwen seg tikkal imezwura i d-yettbanen deg ultrason, aṭas yettwakkes d lwaqt yettwattkal deg usentem-ik.
BabyDevelopment.17: Zdat ddurt 20, tezmer ad tḥussed s yimenzayen imezwura n uqcic amecṭuḥ. Daɣen dagi ara bdun tuḥsest ad tt-d-ttwarẓen.
BabyDevelopment.18: Seg trimestre wis kraḍ, aqcic amecṭuḥ yettaɣ aṭas n wazal u ad yesbedd iman-is i tlalit.
BabyDevelopment.19: Taqeddict n tegga temxalef seg uqcic amecṭuḥ ɣer wayeḍ: tiwsatin-a qqimen d azal amatu kan.
BabyDevelopment.20: Seg 6 n ddurt: ul ibeddu ittaḍḍu
BabyDevelopment.21: Zdat 20 n ddurt: tḥussed s yimenzayen imezwura
BabyDevelopment.23: Zdat 28 n ddurt: allen rennun ad ldint
BabyDevelopment.24: Aqcic amecṭuḥ “isla i yal ayen” seg tazwara: tsest ur tettemmed ara d tideg trimestre wis sin
BabyDevelopment.25: Talɣa n tebuqqet tebnu lǧins n uqcic amecṭuḥ: ulac aḥdayen ussnan i ibeṭṭen wagi
BabyDevelopment.26: Aqcic amecṭuḥ yettazzan aṭas yelha ugar: taqeddict tmxalaf aṭas seg yiwen ɣer wayeḍ
BabyDevelopment.28: Yal asmel n tegga n uqcic amecṭuḥ yeṭṭef abrid-is; asenqed n ṭṭbib yal ass ɛawen ad yettwabbɛed ayen akk iteddu akken ilaq.

BasalTemperature.1:
Aḍfar n temdit n
udem n ddaw
BasalTemperature.6: Tarrayt tabsiṭ i usentem, deffir ayen, belli ovulation teḍra.
BasalTemperature.8: D acu-t temdit n ddaw n lǧism?
BasalTemperature.15: Temdit n ddaw n lǧism d temdit n lǧism-ik deg ukuc ummid, uqbel yal armud. Tettbeddil s lemqas amecṭuḥ aṭas deg ucal n yimalasen, s lḥekma n hormone-ik.
BasalTemperature.16: Tettwamedr yal ṣṣbeḥ, uqbel ad d-tekkseḍ, yal tikkelt deg yiwen n wakud d yiwen n termumit.
BasalTemperature.18: Seqdec yal tikkelt yiwen n termumit, s wudem ilelliyen yiwen n ddaw (ugar n lḥeqq, alamma ɣer ddacra n tazmilt).
BasalTemperature.20: Mmed deg yiwen n wakud yeṭṭfen, uqbel ad d-tekkseḍ, deffir ugar n 3 n tsaɛtin n unebdu ur d-yeḥbiseṭ.
BasalTemperature.22: Aru amedrar ass n lawan, uqbel ad d-tekkseḍ neɣ ad tmeslayeḍ.
BasalTemperature.23: Temdit n ddaw n lǧism tettali s lemqas amecṭuḥ (0.2 ɣer 0.5°C) kra kra deffir ovulation, s lḥekma n progesterone, u teqqim d tameqqrant alamma d lḥid i d-yeddan.
BasalTemperature.25: Meẓẓi deg uḥric amezwaru n ucal, tettali deffir ovulation u teqqim dinna — talɣa-a ur tban ara ala deffir kra n wussan n usemmed.
BasalTemperature.27: Asennan deg wakud ur nelhi ara
BasalTemperature.29: Aksum i yerran tgudi n yimeddiden
BasalTemperature.31: Wagi mačči d tarrayt n usenwi maca d ta n usentem: tɛawen ad tfehmeḍ ucal-ik ugar, mi ara teḍru ovulation — mačči i usenwi-ines.
BasalTemperature.32: Tamɣarit weḥd-s deg yiwen neɣ sin n yimalasen ur yekfi ara s umata: talɣa tban s usɛiwed.
BasalTemperature.33: Yelha ad tmeslayeḍ d unaẓur ɣef
BasalTemperature.34: Ulac asali n temdit deg waṭas n yimalasen ummiden
BasalTemperature.35: Timdit qqimen ur nelhi ara d lemqas ur yettwakkes ara akken ilaq
BasalTemperature.36: Tesɛiḍ isteqsiyen ɣef tazdayt-ik ur yezmir ara usentem-a weḥd-s ad ten-yerr
BasalTemperature.38: Tazmilt n temdit n ddaw n lǧism d usmuzzeg n mucus n ujeǧǧig neɣ ineẓrayen n ovulation tefk tamuɣli tummidt ɣef ucal-ik.
BasalTemperature.39: Temdit n ddaw n lǧism tettali s lemqas amecṭuḥ (0.2 ɣer 0.5°C) kra kra deffir ovulation, s lḥekma n progesterone.

BasalTemperature.41: Wagi mačči d tarrayt n usenwi maca d ta n usentem: tɛawen ad tfehmeḍ ucal-ik ugar.

BirthControlPills.6: Amek i teddu tameḥbust, amek ara tt-tmeḍleḍ yal ass, d wayen-nsent igerrzen d tilas-is.
BirthControlPills.9: Ad tt-tmeḍleḍ akken ilaq yal ass
BirthControlPills.12: Tameḥbust tesɛa hormone — estrogen d/neɣ progestin, ɣef umata n wanaw — i iteddun s uḥbas neɣ ussewweḍ n ovulation. Daɣen tbeddil mucus n ujeǧǧig, ayen i yerran tuɣalin n lemni d tawɛert.
BirthControlPills.14: Llan aṭas n wanawen n tmeḥbusin, s umata tid ibedden s sin n hormone d tid n progestin kan. Akk-nsent zemrent ad xtalfent deg ugbur d wamek ara ttwamḍent.
BirthControlPills.15: Ad tt-tmeḍleḍ s uḍfar yelha. Ɣef wanaw n tmeḥbust, ayen ilaqen ad txedmeḍ mi ara tettuḍ yiwen n wakud yettemxalaf — ihi ilaq ad tɣreḍ ccrit n ddwa.
BirthControlPills.16: Fren akud n wass i d-yebnan s uktay (imensi, tiḍ...)
BirthControlPills.17: Seqdec asmekti neɣ asnas ma yella ilaq
BirthControlPills.18: Eǧǧ ccrit n ddwa ɣer yidis ma tesɛiḍ ccek
BirthControlPills.19: Am yal tarrayt n usebbel, tameḥbust tesɛa lfayda maca daɣen tilas ilaqen ad tessneḍ uqbel ad tt-tferneḍ.
BirthControlPills.22: Tessenqes aṭas ṭṭer n lḥemla ma tettwaseqdec akken ilaq
BirthControlPills.23: Tezmer ad terr lḥid yettwaṭṭef ugar d wayen i d-yettbanen
BirthControlPills.24: Tezmer ad tessenqes ṭṭṛaḥ d idammen i kra n yimdanen
BirthControlPills.25: Tezmer ad tettwabeddel neɣ ad tettwasenfel ma ur k-telhi ara
BirthControlPills.28: Tehwaǧ ad tt-tmeḍleḍ s uḍfar, ɣef wanaw n tmeḥbust
BirthControlPills.29: Ttuḍ n tmeḥbust zemren ad ssenqsen tazmert-is
BirthControlPills.30: Kra n yimdanen zemren ad ɛerḍen ayen i d-yettaken seg ugar
BirthControlPills.31: Ur tḥerres ara seg yimuttiyen i d-yettawin s ujmaḥ (STIs)
BirthControlPills.33: Tameḥbust d tarrayt n usebbel s hormone yelhan ma tettwaseqdec akken ilaq. Ad tt-tmeḍleḍ s uḍfar, ayen i d-yettaken seg ugar, d tuɣ n ukkaw seg STIs d tiktiwin yelhan ad tissneḍ.
BirthControlPills.34: Ma tettxemmimeḍ ɣef usebbel neɣ tarrayt-ik n tura ur k-telhi ara, ur tettaggadeḍ ara ad tmeslayeḍ d ṭṭbib, tqabalt neɣ anaẓur-nniḍen n tezmert.

BoneHealth.6: Acuɣer menopause tessemɣur ṭṭer n osteoporosis, u amek ara tḥerzeḍ iɣsan-ik yal ass.
BoneHealth.14: Estrogen ttɛawan s tilawt ad ḥerzen tazmert n yiɣsan s usqerreb n ubeddil n yiɣsan. Tuɣ n estrogen deg menopause tezzerr ttaɣ n yiɣsan, s umata deg useggwas imezwura deffir ma yeḥbes lḥid.
BoneHealth.15: Osteopenia d tazmert n yiɣsan yessenqsen ugar n tikkelt, ur d-yewweḍ ara ɣer tahaṛt n osteoporosis. Osteoporosis d taẓayt n yiɣsan tameqqrant ara yessemɣaren ṭṭer n wuḍem, aseggas mi ara ṭṭuḍeḍ.
BoneHealth.17: Sin n wawalen-a rnan tuɣ n tazmert n yiɣsan, mačči aḥrir yeḍran yakan — d asmekti i uḥrez, mačči d ssebba n uḥezzeb.
BoneHealth.18: Asenqed-a ur d-yesseḥmal ara yeḍra, yemmed tazmert n yiɣsan. Tezmer ad yettwabda ɣef leɛmeṛ-ik, d umezruy-ik d wid n twacult-ik, neɣ tiwsatin-nniḍen n ṭṭer i d-yettwafen d ṭṭbib-ik.
BoneHealth.20: Vitamin D (tafat n yitij s lemqas, ččaṛ)
BoneHealth.21: Armud n lǧism (aseggwer, armud n tezmert)
BoneHealth.25: Tabɣa n tura neɣ n zik
BoneHealth.26: Lǧism yettɛeṭṭilen aṭas neɣ armud aqerrab
BoneHealth.28: Ma tesɛiḍ yiwen neɣ ugar seg wayen-a ur yeɛni ara ad tkecmeḍ ɣer osteoporosis — llan kan i usnerni n unemmeslay d ṭṭbib-ik ɣef usenqed izemren.
BoneHealth.30: Calcium, vitamin D d armud n lǧism ttwaɣen d iɣawsiwen n yal ass yelhan ugar i uḥrez n tezmert n yiɣsan deg wakud ucrik.
BoneHealth.31: Ḥrez ɣef tigemmi n yiɣsan-ik — AWA

Breastfeeding.16: Tizuzt tsebded s lemqas. Tisaɛtin timezwura, sakkin ussan imezwura, ttaken akud i uqcic amecṭuḥ d yemma-s ad ssnen ɣef wayen.
Breastfeeding.20: Amennuɣ n tzeddigt ɣer tzeddigt d ameɣbun uzwar zemren ad ɛawnen tizuzt ad tebdu akken ilaq.

Breastfeeding.34: Amḍan n yimellalen yetthuyen d wid yettwaslafen d yiwen seg wayen ilaqen ad tẓerreḍ yal ass.
Breastfeeding.36: Adeg yelhan d umɣebbun yelhan zemren ad sselhin tizuzin. Ma yella wawal ameqqran neɣ yettqimen, anaẓur n tezmert yezmer ad yessenqed adeg d umɣebbun.

Breastfeeding.44: Ṛǧu alamma yeldi imi-s s waṭas uqbel ad k-d-tefkeḍ tazuzt.
Breastfeeding.46: Ameɣbun yelhan ur yessefk ara ad d-yawi wawal ameqqran neɣ yettqimen.

Breastfeeding.50: Ur tlaq ara ad tṛǧuḍ alamma tuɣalin tinneɣ. Anaẓur yettwaklen yezmer ad yɛawen ad yettwasenqed adeg, ameɣbun, neɣ ilaq n uqcic amecṭuḥ.

ChildbirthPrep.19: Ilebsan yelhan i kečč d uqcic amecṭuḥ
ChildbirthPrep.20: Lǧerrayat n tgemmi d tiqeffalin n deffir tlalit
ChildbirthPrep.21: Alebsu i uqcic amecṭuḥ i tuɣalin ɣer wexxam
ChildbirthPrep.22: Ayen tebɣiḍ i usenqes n ṭṭṛaḥ
ChildbirthPrep.23: Win tebɣiḍ ad yili yidek deg tlalit
ChildbirthPrep.24: Ayen tettṛaǧuḍ ɣef umennuɣ n tzeddigt ɣer tzeddigt
ChildbirthPrep.25: Aɣawas afessas n tlalit ɛawen ad tbeṭṭuḍ tinniyin-ik d uɣref n ṭṭbib, u ad teqqimeḍ d tamsalt ldin: tuɣalin n tmenzayt tezmer ad tbeddel ɣef waddad.
ChildbirthPrep.27: Aheggi ur yeɛni ara ad tḥekmeḍ ɣef yal ayen: d ayen ad tefkeḍ iman-ik ineggura i uqeṛṛeb n wass ameqqran s tkeyyest ugar u s wugur n uḥezzeb.
ChildbirthPrep.28: Ttheggu s lehna i tlalit — AWA

ChooseHormonalMethod.6: Isteqsiyen ilhan i ten-testeqsiḍ iman-ik i usnulfu n tarrayt n usebbel tella d tudert-ik n yal ass, ilaq-ik d usentem-ik.
ChooseHormonalMethod.9: Ulac tarrayt “yelhan akk” s lmeɛna ummid
ChooseHormonalMethod.13: Ulac yiwet n tarrayt n usebbel i yelhan i wid akk. Uqbel ad tferneḍ, yelha ad tettxemmimeḍ ɣef tɣawsiwin-ik, wayen i k-yehwan, ayen ara tebdeḍ, d usentem-ik.
ChooseHormonalMethod.15: Ilaq-iyi ad txedmeɣ yal ass neɣ yal ddurt, neɣ tarrayt yetteddun aṭas?
ChooseHormonalMethod.16: Sɛiɣ asentem n lḥemla deg wakud alemmas?
ChooseHormonalMethod.17: D acu-t uzemz-iw, u amek ara ufɣeɣ ɣer tarrayt-a n usebbel?
ChooseHormonalMethod.18: Sin n yimdanen zemren ad fernen tarrayin yemxalafen, u sin-nsen xedmen afren yemṣaḥ s waddad-nsen. Afren ilhan yettkel s wamek tebɣiḍ ad tseqdceḍ asebbel d ayen i d-tettnadiḍ.
ChooseHormonalMethod.20: Tarrayt tettban d tamelha deg tkaɣeḍt ur tella ara dima d ta yelhan ugar i kečč yal ass.
ChooseHormonalMethod.21: I usemgirred n kra n yiferdisen, tzemreḍ ad terreḍ tamuɣli ɣer yimsedwa yemxalafen. Armud-a ur yeɛni ara ad tessneḍ akk ɣef wul, maca ad tafeḍ ayen i k-yeḥwajen s tidet.
ChooseHormonalMethod.23: Kra n tarrayin ttuhwaǧent armud n yal ass, wiyaḍ kan ɛeṭṭlen yal ddurt, neɣ ugar n wakud.
ChooseHormonalMethod.25: Ayen i d-tḥussed yezmer ad yextalef seg yiwen ɣer wayeḍ. Yelha ad tẓerreḍ amek i d-yetteddu lǧism-ik u ad tmeslayeḍ ma yella kra i k-yettḥuzzin.
ChooseHormonalMethod.27: Ma tettṛaǧuḍ lḥemla zik, ɣer-s lqedd n useqdec d tuɣalin n tazdayt deffir uḥbas zemren ad ilin deg wayen ara tmeslayeḍ.
ChooseHormonalMethod.29: Tiwwuri ur tettwali ara kan tarrayt i d-ffreneḍ, maca daɣen amek ara tt-tseqdceḍ akken ilaq u s uḍfar.
ChooseHormonalMethod.31: Yiwen n usemgirred ameqqran gar tarrayin d ccḥal n tikkal ilaq ad tettxemmimeḍ ɣef usebbel-ik.
ChooseHormonalMethod.43: Tarrayt s hormone tezmer ad tḥussed-itt akken i d-tella seg yiwen ɣer wayeḍ. Kra ttwalin ibeddilen deg ucal-nsen, idammen, neɣ ayen i d-yettaken seg ugar. Ibeddilen-a ur d-yeɛni ara s uttekki belli tarrayt ur k-telhi ara, maca yelha ad tqeḍɛeḍ ɣef-sen tamuɣli.
ChooseHormonalMethod.45: Ma yella ubeddil ameqqran, yettqimen neɣ ur d-yettwaẓar ara, ur teqqimeḍ ara weḥd-ek d isteqsiyen-ik. Aṭṭbib, tqabalt neɣ anaẓur-nniḍen n tezmert zemren ad k-ɛawen ad tafeḍ ma ilaq ad tkemmleḍ, ad tettbeddleḍ neɣ ad tbeddeleḍ tarrayt.
ChooseHormonalMethod.47: Tinniyin-ik n lḥemla zemrent daɣen ad ḥekmen ɣef ufren-ik. Ma tebɣiḍ ad tzegleḍ lḥemla i kra n iseggasen, tarrayt yettemɣaren tezmer ad tili d tin ilaqen. Ma tettxemmimeḍ ɣef lḥemla uzwar, tarrayin-nniḍen zemrent ad msalaken d wakud-ik.
ChooseHormonalMethod.49: Mmeslay ɣef tinniyin-ik n lḥemla, ɣas ma llant ibeɛden neɣ ur llint ara ttwabeddent, ɛawen anaẓur n tezmert ad k-d-yawi akken ilaq.
ChooseHormonalMethod.50: Asentem yettaken-ak-d ad tẓerreḍ lfayda, tilas d ayen izemren ad yessemgen ɣef yal tarrayt. Tzemreḍ ad theggaḍ kra n yisteqsiyen uqbel ur tettuḍ ara ayen yelhan.
ChooseHormonalMethod.52: D acu-t lfayda n tarrayt-a fell-i?
ChooseHormonalMethod.53: D acu n ugdil ara d-yeḍru fell-i?
ChooseHormonalMethod.55: D acu ara xedmeɣ ma ttuɣ-tt, ma tettwazzel deg wadeg-is, neɣ ma bɣiɣ ad tt-ḥbesɣ?
ChooseHormonalMethod.56: Tarrayt-a tella d tinniyin-iw n lḥemla?
ChooseHormonalMethod.58: Tqabalt neɣ aṭṭbib zemren ad ḥesbent amezruy-ik n tezmert, ddwa-ik, ayen i k-yehwan d tudert-ik uqbel ad ssumren tarrayt.
ChooseHormonalMethod.60: Fren tarrayt i yemṣaḥ d tudert-ik n yal ass.
ChooseHormonalMethod.61: Ḥseb tidet-ik n usenqes d ayen i k-yehwan.
ChooseHormonalMethod.62: Ttxemmim ɣef tinniyin-ik n lḥemla d wakud-ik.
ChooseHormonalMethod.63: Suter tallelt n unaẓur ma ur tessineḍ ara.
ChooseHormonalMethod.65: Tarrayt yelhan mačči d tin ibanen d ayen yeffsun ugar neɣ d ayen yettwasnen ugar. D tin yemṣaḥ d waddad-ik, ilaq-ik d ayen i k-yehwan, deffir tamsalt yelhan d unaẓur n tezmert.
ChooseHormonalMethod.66: Amagrad-a d i ussenfar kan u ur yettekkes ara tallelt n ṭṭbib.
ChooseHormonalMethod.67: Afren n tmeẓlit i k-ilhan — AWA

ConceptionLifestyle.1:
Tiɣawsiwin n tudert d
ubrid-ik ɣer lḥemla
ConceptionLifestyle.6: Tiɣawsiwin tifessasin izemren ad ɛawnent abrid-ik — war ṭṭṛaḥ.
ConceptionLifestyle.9: Stres, tamsalt ur ilaq ara ad tettuḍ
ConceptionLifestyle.12: Kra n tiɣawsiwin tifessasin n tudert zemrent ad ɛawnent abrid ɣer lḥemla, ɣas ur zemrent ara ad ḍmenent igmad weḥd-sent.
ConceptionLifestyle.17: Stres yettqimen yezmer ad iḥekkem ɣef umsawal n hormone u, deg kra n tilawin, ɣef lḥid n ucal. Ad tefkeḍ iman-ik tiɣraḍin n lehna d aḥric n abrid.
ConceptionLifestyle.19: Tebɣiḍ ad txedmeḍ “yal ayen akken ilaq” yezmer ad yuɣal d ssebba n stres: yeɣni ad tfaṛseḍ s tiɣawsiwin yelhan s umata, war ukemmel.
ConceptionLifestyle.20: Tabɣa, i izemren ad tḥekkem ɣef tazdayt n sin yimsawalen
ConceptionLifestyle.22: Armud n lǧism yewɛer yettqimen, ayen izemren ad yeḥbes tazdayt s wudem anmettiy
ConceptionLifestyle.23: Aṭas n sukkar yettwasfan, izemren ad isenqes amsawal n hormone
ConceptionLifestyle.25: Tiɣawsiwin yemṣaḥen s umata, war ukemmel neɣ usebbel, d tallelt yelhan n yal ass.
ConceptionLifestyle.26: Tiɣawsiwin n tudert d abrid ɣer lḥemla — AWA

ConceptionStart.1:
Asennur n lḥemla:
anda ara tebduḍ
ConceptionStart.6: Tiwsatin igerrzen i usenbadu n abrid-ik ɣer lḥemla s tkeyyest.
ConceptionStart.12: Aɣawas amezwaru yelhan ugar d asnen n tegwejdit-ik n tazdayt s uyla n ucal-ik: ɣer-s, talɣa n lǧism, u, ma tebɣiḍ, ibenyan n uḍfar am yineẓrayen n ovulation neɣ temdit n ddaw n lǧism.
ConceptionStart.13: Ad tesɛuḍ tameddurt tamgarant s uḍfar, yal 2 ɣer 3 n wussan, tegzen s lemqas aṭas n wakud ilaqen war aɣref ur nelhi ara.
ConceptionStart.14: Ur tlaq ara ad tgedleḍ iman-ik ɣer wass n ovulation kan
ConceptionStart.15: Arrad yemṣaḥ yewhaǧ ad yettwaḥrez ugar n lǧadwal yeqqnen
ConceptionStart.16: Aɛebbi n tgeṭṭunt yesɛa azal daɣen deg wakud-a
ConceptionStart.17: Ugar n tmeddukelt tesɛa lḥemla deg 12 n wayyuren seld ma ḥebsen asebbel. Wakud-a yemxalaf ɣef waṭas n yimsedwa i yal addad.
ConceptionStart.19: Deffir 12 n wayyuren (neɣ 6 n wayyuren deffir leɛmeṛ 35), yelha ad tẓerreḍ anaẓur n tezmert i usenqed, ɣas ur yeɛni ara s tidet belli yella wugur.
ConceptionStart.21: Asnen n ucal-ik, aḥrez n arrad amagnu, d uṣber, d tidgitin n tazwara n lehna n abrid-a.
ConceptionStart.22: Asennur n lḥemla: anda ara tebduḍ — AWA
